newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank refinancing loans down in March.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank refinancing loans down in March.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) refinancing loans fell by 4.6 percent in March after a 11.3 percent drop in February, with Lombard credits and structural facilities on the slide, BNR data showed on Thursday.

The total daily refinancing was 5.9 trillion lei on average in March, when the Lombard loans dipped to 32.6 billion from February's 166.6 billion with the money market turning liquid after shortages under a BNR drive to soak up excess funds.

Structural refinancing facilities, for which the BNR charges a discount rate of 50 percent, fell to 2.3 trillion lei from 2.6 trillion, while soft loans for farmers also slipped to 896 billion lei in March from 962 billion in February.
Auctioned credits went down to 530.3 billion in March from 563.4 billion in February, when they saw a sharp plunge.

Credits granted to debtors in dispute at law, respectively to troubled banks Dacia Felix SA and Renasterea Creditului Romanesc Credit Bank SA, stayed flat at 1.87 billion lei. The BNR does not charge interest on loans to those debtors.
Both banks, which had big debts and huge losses, await courts ruling on their fate -- reorganisation or liquidation.
At end-February the BNR gave 52 billion lei in refinancing funds to Dacia Felix to help it redeem small depositors.
